_about: Pages whose free email lists carry events about his job hunt and his move (Project Reboot: Sioux Falls). With the sign-ups switch on (ruling sign-ups-on), she visits each page once and, only if it offers a FREE email list, puts his name and email on it, so invitations reach his inbox and the inbox path signs him up. A page with no free list, a price, an account or a robot check is left and recorded. A reviewed edit adds a page; nothing in code names a place.
